newsitem.title: GERMANY: German court permits far-right party rally.
newsitem.headline: German court permits far-right party rally.

text.p: The far-right National Party of Germany (NPD) will be permitted to hold a rally in Bonn, despite police objections, on the country's national Unity Day holiday, a court ruled on Wednesday.

An administrative court in Cologne, which has jurisdiction over nearby Bonn, lifted a ban that Bonn police had imposed on the small party whose German name -- Nationaldemokratische Partei Deutschlands -- is similar to that of the outlawed Nazi party.

Police wanted to ban the rally, to be held in Bonn's town centre on Thursday, on grounds that it would present a danger to public safety. They said the event might become violent because far-left groups could try to interrupt it.
The court said the police did not present sufficient evidence that the rally would pose a danger.
